name: Eleven Weeks
blurb: Waerhaven builds the fleet the Ythan League has instead of an army, on a promontory with no river, behind one landward gate and a chain it can drop across the harbour in four minutes. It also has nineteen hundred people from Drennmark living outside the wall, in a suburb the League's charter says does not exist, doing the work that keeps the slipways moving. Everyone involved has a reason not to notice. The whole arrangement stands on the League Granary, the Factor has told Lathmere it holds twenty weeks of grain, and it holds eleven.
